# Sound Cocktail — full details

> Sound Cocktail is a free sound-therapy listening site. Tune 22 sounds — rain, fire, café voices, night train, piano — into a mix for the moment you are in, and save it for sleep, focus or unwinding. No app to install, no account needed to listen.

## What it is

Sound Cocktail is a web app for place-inspired sound journeys: real film, original music and sound layers you can tune, for focus, sleep and meditation. Pick a state, enter the room, and tune the layers until it sounds like tonight. Sounds come from three sources: live field recordings, instrument samples, and a live synthesis engine with per-sound tuning (brightness, distance, density). The free entry is the Chiang Mai and Bali journeys, a 10-minute listening window and the basic tuner; Plus unlocks the other four destinations, unlimited listening, the full tuner and the sleep timer.

Save mixes as recipes, share a recipe card or a recipe code (SYL-...) with a friend.

- [Sound Cocktail 进阶](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/plus): 订阅：全部六个目的地、不限时收听、完整调音与睡眠定时。月付 $7.99 / ¥18，年付 $79.90 / ¥180。海外订阅含 7 天免费试用。

## Sounds (22)

Nature: rain, wind, waves, stream, thunder, birds, insects, fire, forest.
Places: café voices, traffic, night train, rural night, market, rainy street, boat cabin, keyboard taps.
Instruments: piano, guitar, wind chimes, wooden fish & drum, harp notes.

## Sound Cocktail Plus (subscription)

- Monthly ($7.99 / ¥18): all six destinations, unlimited listening, the full tuner, saved mixes and the sleep timer.
- Yearly ($79.90 / ¥180): the same, for a year. Overseas subscriptions include a 7-day free trial; domestic Alipay cards are one-time purchases with no trial.

Payment follows the visitor's region: China pays in CNY via Alipay; elsewhere pays in USD via Waffo. The interface language (English / 中文) is independent of payment — switching language never changes the price or payment method.

## Facts

- Listening is free, with sessions of up to 10 minutes each, and no account needed to listen. Accounts (email or Google) are only needed to subscribe and keep entitlements.
- Sound Cocktail is made by an independent developer. It is not a medical product and does not treat insomnia, anxiety or tinnitus — it is for winding down, focusing and relaxing.
- Real field recordings on the site are listed with their source and license on the site's sources section.
